name: Archer
fantasy: The warden of high ground. Climbs, reads the field, pins people to walls.
silhouette: the long weapon over the shoulder

card.loop: Snares root and feed Focus; full Focus makes your next shot into a rooted foe a Deadeye. Run foes down to heal and dash again.
card.dash: Fire a grapple line: zip up a ledge, or hop back. A knock gives a charge back.
card.passive: Focus builds standing still or on a snare; full = Deadeye. Hurt foes show through cover; a knock heals.
card.rmb: Tap: a rooting snare. Hold: a Heavy Shot; into a wall it hits again and pins.
card.e: A wall of falling arrows across their path for 4.5s: damage, slow, blight.

weapons.longbow: Hold to draw in stages: 30, then 60 at full; let go right at a stage (PERFECT) for a bonus.

passive.name: Focus
passive.desc: Builds while you stand still (full in 1.4s), sneak (2.8s), 50% faster on high ground; a snare or Heavy Shot that hits adds 40 (a wall pin fills it). Drains while running and drops 40 when hit. At 100 your next shot is fully drawn or aimed at once, with +20% range, and if it hits a rooted or stunned foe it is a Deadeye: +18 damage, a crit. Hawk Sense: rivals under half health are seen through cover within 22m. A knock heals 18 and gives a dash charge back.

dash.name: Grapple Arrow
dash.desc: A line arrow at the cursor (9m). If it bites a wall, rock or ledge you zip to it and climb on top; if it bites nothing you hop 3.2m back. Works from a glide and cools it.

variants.tap: A snare arrow 11m: 8 damage and root 0.6 on a foe; on the ground it plants a Tripwire (root 1.2, reveal 3s).
variants.hold: Heavy Shot: charge 0.5s -> full at 1.1s (rising creak, a ring, a ping at full): 16 -> 30 damage, push 6 -> 12, pierces 2; driven into a wall within 3m it hits again (up to 12) and stuns 1.2 (PINNED).
variants.air: Plunge: shoot straight down, push 8 around you, lift yourself 3m, cool the glider.
variants.during_e: With your Hail Wall falling the tap snare roots 1.0.

e.name: Hail Wall
e.desc: Lob a volley up to 9m: 0.35s later a wall of arrows falls along a 6m line across your aim for 4.5s. Foes inside take 5 every 0.5s, are slowed 35% and blighted (healing barely takes).

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 7.2s, damage +30%; max 3 live Tripwires.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 15s -> 12s, damage +30%; the Hail Wall is 30% wider.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 7s -> 4.9s; the backward hop refunds 40%.

tells.full: a bright glint and a thin aim line; crosshairs over every rooted foe
tells.dash_spent: the rope line, dash pip dark
